Suffolk Capital Management Llc decreased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 43.09% based on its latest 2017Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Suffolk Capital Management Llc who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $894.09B market cap company. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 62.48% since March 3, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 45.78% the S&P500.
